determinism.objectKeyOrder: Object keys are ordered on serialization, recursively, including inside recorded response bodies. Array order is the server's own and is preserved.

omittedResponseHeaders.access-control-*: CORS is deployment configuration (CORS_ORIGIN), not operation semantics. The recording would pin one deployment.
omittedResponseHeaders.connection: Transport framing, decided by the HTTP agent.
omittedResponseHeaders.content-length: Derived from the body already recorded, and a stale copy of it would be worse than none.
omittedResponseHeaders.date: Wall clock. Changes on every run by construction.
omittedResponseHeaders.keep-alive: Transport framing, decided by the HTTP agent.
omittedResponseHeaders.x-ezclassify-license-*: Licensing state of the recording deployment. Says nothing about the operation.
omittedResponseHeaders.x-ratelimit-*: Per-window counters. They change with every request, including repeats of the same one.
omittedResponseHeaders.x-request-id: Per-request correlation id. A fresh UUID every time.

pathPlaceholders.<recording-deployment-artifact-dir>: Writable state directory (EZCLASSIFY_ARTIFACT_DIR). A fresh temporary directory per recording run.
pathPlaceholders.<recording-deployment-root>: Directory the recording deployment's license, trust manifest and credentials are written to. A fresh temporary directory per recording run.
